introH2: 🏖️ What is Patong Beach like, and which part should you stay in?
introHtml: Patong is Phuket's loudest, most energetic beach — a 3-kilometre curve of sand on the island's west coast, packed by day with sun-loungers, jet-skis and banana boats, while after dark Bangla Road turns into a neon walking street that barely sleeps, ringed by the Jungceylon mall, night markets, massage shops and a restaurant every few steps · But Patong isn't all chaos if you know which zone to pick · The southern end and the headland hide resorts with private beaches that feel like a different town · Along the beach road (Thawewong) sit hotels where you open the curtains to the sea and cross the road to the sand · and the town centre around Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Road is where you can walk to both the beach and Bangla on a lighter budget · Book the wrong zone and the whole mood of your trip changes — you wanted to walk home after Bangla but ended up on a headland that needs a car, or brought a toddler to sleep in the middle of the nightlife · This guide gathers 10 Patong Beach hotels we've reviewed in depth, covering every budget and every zone — all built from reading real guest reviews, with the good and the honest caveats spelled out, prices compared across 3 booking sites, and direct links to book
mrtHtml: Phuket has no rail transit — you'll get around by rental car, Grab, taxi, tuk-tuk or hotel transfer · Patong sits on the island's west coast, about 40–50 minutes from Phuket Airport (HKT) · The zones in this guide: On the beach road (Thawewong) — open the curtains to the sea or cross the road to the sand (Four Points on the northern Kalim end · Holiday Inn across from the beach in the centre · The Bloc on the headland by Bangla) · Town centre, Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee / Sawatdirak — walkable to the beach and Bangla, lighter on price (The Kee · Deevana · Hotel Indigo · Lub d) · South Patong, Ruamjai soi — a garden boutique 2–3 minutes from the sand (Burasari) · The southern headland — a quiet private cove, 5–10 minutes' drive into town (Amari) · Tri-Trang Beach, Patong's southern edge — a private bay away from the noise, with a shuttle into Patong (Marriott Merlin) · After dark the town centre is walkable without a car, while the headland and Tri-Trang stays mean budgeting for taxis

toc.name: Four Points by Sheraton Patong Beach

entries.name: Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach
entries.revCount: Score 9.0 · 2,843 reviews · 414 rooms · private Tri-Trang Beach
entries.badge: 🏖️ Best private-beach resort in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tri-Trang Beach, Patong's southern edge · ~5–10 min to Bangla
tags: 🏖️ Private Tri-Trang Beach, snorkelling
🏊 3 pools + swim-up bar + kids' slide pool
🦋 Kids Club + Merlin butterfly garden

entries.addr: 99 Muen-Ngoen Road, Tri-Trang Beach, Patong, Kathu, Phuket
entries.storyHtml: If you want Patong in a quieter, more private form — waking up to your own beach yet still a few minutes' drive from Bangla Road — Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach is the answer many families and couples choose · A 5-star Marriott resort on a private bay called Tri-Trang Beach (Merlin Beach) on Patong's southern edge, with 414 rooms, a major 2020 renovation, 3 pools (including a swim-up bar and a kids' slide pool), a private beach you can snorkel off, a Kids Club and a butterfly garden. It scores 9.0 from 2,843 reviews — the highest in this list — with service and family-friendliness singled out as its strengths · The honest caveats: it's not in central Patong, so it's a 5–10 minute drive to Bangla, the resort is large and spread over a hillside with plenty of walking, some older buildings don't soundproof well between rooms, and peak-season rates run high with extra charges to watch (guests aged 12+ on an extra bed, for one) — book low season and the value improves clearly · Best for families and couples who want a quiet private-beach resort with Marriott standards, still close to Patong
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Snorkel off Tri-Trang Beach in the morning when the water is clear and the crowd is thin · Ask for a room in a building near the lobby/pool if you don't want to walk the hill, or upgrade to an Ocean View for a balcony over the bay · Check the Patong shuttle schedule on day one, and consider the half-board package that many reviews call good value
pros: Quiet private Tri-Trang Beach with clear, snorkellable water · 9.0, the top score here
3 pools with a kids' slide pool, swim-up bar, Kids Club and butterfly garden — built for families
Large, clean rooms, many with a balcony or sea view · warm, praised service
cons: Not in central Patong — a 5–10 minute drive to Bangla and the malls
Large hillside resort with lots of walking · some older buildings soundproof poorly
High peak-season rates plus extra charges like an extra bed for guests aged 12+ (from reviews)

entries.name: Four Points by Sheraton Phuket Patong Beach Resort
entries.revCount: Score 8.6 · 5,078 reviews · biggest review base in this list
entries.badge: 🌊 A real Patong beachfront · biggest review base

tags: 🏖️ A real Patong beachfront, sea from the room
🏊 Saltwater lagoon + rooftop + kids' pool
🍳 Chao Leh Kitchen breakfast, widely praised
👨‍👩‍👧 Little Sea Gypsies kids club + family rooms
entries.storyHtml: Patong is famous for its buzz, but plenty of people want the sea and a bit of calm without sleeping on top of Bangla Road — Four Points by Sheraton Phuket Patong Beach Resort hits exactly that note · A 600-room beachfront resort opened in late 2020 (Thailand's first beachfront Four Points) on Thawewong Road at the northern Kalim end of Patong Beach — quieter than the centre, yet still a ~15-minute walk along the sand to Bangla. It has a saltwater lagoon pool, a rooftop pool, a kids' pool, The Deck beach club, and breakfast at Chao Leh Kitchen that reviews rate among Patong's best. It scores 8.6 from 5,078 reviews — the biggest review base in this list · The honest caveats: there's no spa on site (you'll use a day spa nearby), the Kalim beachfront is narrow and rocky at high tide, in-house food and drink run pricey, and it's a big hotel where the pools and breakfast get busy at peak times · Best for families and couples who want a new, clean beachfront hotel at a reachable price
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Request a high-floor Ocean View at booking, since some rooms face the building or car park with a very different view · Pool Access rooms are limited, so book ahead · Include breakfast — Chao Leh Kitchen is genuinely good — and eat other meals at Patong's cheaper restaurants nearby
pros: Genuinely on Patong Beach — Andaman views from the room and rooftop pool · huge 5,078-review base
New, spacious, clean rooms (opened 2020) · saltwater lagoon + rooftop + kids' pool
Praised Chao Leh Kitchen breakfast · family-friendly with a kids club
cons: No spa on site — you'll head out to a day spa nearby
The Kalim beachfront is narrow and rocky at high tide
Pricey in-house dining · big hotel, so pools and breakfast get busy at peak (from reviews)

entries.name: Burasari Phuket Resort & Spa
entries.revCount: Score 8.8 · 2,300+ reviews · 2–3 min walk to the beach
entries.mrtTag: 📍 South Patong, Ruamjai soi · 2–3 min walk to the sand (~50 m)
tags: 🌺 Low-rise, bright colours, lotus headboards
🏊 Several pools + swim-up pool bar
💆 Award-winning Spa Burasari
💑 Pool Access / Honeymoon rooms with outdoor tubs
entries.storyHtml: If you want a stay a few minutes' walk from Patong Beach but don't want to sleep in another identical concrete tower, Burasari Phuket Resort & Spa is a name reviewers keep raising · A 4-star boutique resort set in a tropical garden on the south-Patong side (Ruamjai soi), about 50 metres and a 2–3 minute walk from the sand, with bright low-rise buildings, lotus-carved headboards in orange and green, several pools with a swim-up bar, an award-winning Spa Burasari and the Kantok Thai restaurant. It scores 8.8 from 2,300+ reviews — the highest of the 4-star stays here — with service repeatedly named its number-one strength · The honest caveats: smoking is allowed in several common areas, so the smoke-sensitive struggle to avoid it, some older rooms show their age, and street-facing rooms can catch Patong's night-time noise — pick a renovated garden/pool-side room and flag a non-smoking preference at booking · Best for couples, honeymooners and relaxers who value design, pools and spa over a sea-view tower
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Celebrating something? Pick the Honeymoon Room or Glam Splash with an outdoor tub or jacuzzi · Ask for a renovated garden/pool-side room to dodge older rooms and street noise · If you're smoke-sensitive, request a high-floor non-smoking room from the start
pros: Distinctive garden design · 2–3 min walk to Patong Beach · 8.8, the top 4★ score here
Several pools with a swim-up bar and the award-winning Spa Burasari
Warm, name-remembering service — reviewers' most-praised point · Pool Access/Honeymoon rooms with outdoor tubs
cons: Smoking allowed in several common areas — hard for the smoke-sensitive to avoid
Some older rooms and bathrooms show their age
Not a beachfront room · street-facing rooms catch night-time noise (from reviews)

entries.addr: 52 Thaweewong Road, Patong Beach, Kathu, Phuket
entries.storyHtml: If you want a Patong stay where you cross the road to the beach and walk a little more to Jungceylon and Bangla, yet still have pools and green gardens like a real resort, Holiday Inn Resort Phuket is a name families rebook year after year · A 4-star IHG family resort on Thawewong Road directly across from Patong Beach, with 400+ rooms split into a family-focused Main Wing and the adults-18+ Busakorn Premium Wing, 6 pools, a kids' slide pool, an underwater-themed Kids Club, and a Kids Stay & Eat Free programme that genuinely lightens the bill. It scores 8.7 from 2,729 reviews, with location rated as high as 9.3 · The honest caveats: it's a big, busy resort where the main pool and restaurants fill up at peak, street-facing rooms near Bangla can hear the night-time noise, and crossing Thawewong to the beach needs care with young children · Best for families visiting Patong for the first time, and travellers who want to be central but still have resort pools and gardens
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high-floor garden-side room if noise bothers you, or pick the quieter Busakorn wing · Check whether your rate includes breakfast (some don't, and it's charged per person) · Families should check the Kids Stay & Eat Free terms, and hit the pool early on busy days
pros: Across from Patong Beach, walkable to Jungceylon and Bangla (location 9.3)
A serious family resort — 6 pools, a kids' slide pool, Kids Club and kids stay free on terms
The adults-18+ Busakorn wing is quieter · wide multi-cuisine breakfast buffet
cons: Big, busy resort — the main pool and restaurants crowd at peak
Street-facing rooms near Bangla can hear traffic and night-time music
Crossing Thawewong to the beach needs care, especially with young kids (from reviews)

entries.type: Boutique Resort & Spa 4★ · rooftop bar · in town
entries.name: The Kee Resort & Spa
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Patong · beach ~240 m · Bangla ~150 m

entries.storyHtml: If you want to stay in the heart of Patong — walking distance to the beach, Bangla Road and Jungceylon — but still want a pretty spot to watch the sunset in peace, The Kee Resort & Spa comes up often in reviews · A 4-star boutique hotel of 255 rooms in central Patong, its signature is KEE Sky Lounge, a multi-level, yacht-shaped rooftop bar with a jacuzzi and Andaman sunset views, plus a lagoon pool with a swim-up bar and the Chino-Portuguese The Kee Spa. Entry rooms start around a generous 40 sqm, and it scores 8.4 from 3,600+ reviews, with location rated as high as 9.2 (about 240 m to the beach, 150 m to Bangla) · The honest caveats: being close to Bangla means night-time noise on some sides, value is its lowest-scoring category (7.9 on Booking), and some room types show their age — ask for a high-floor inner room, pick a renovated category, and book low season · Best for couples and friends who come to walk, hit the beach and enjoy the nightlife, and want a rooftop bar and pool in a walk-everywhere location
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high-floor inner room to cut the night-time noise, and pick a Deluxe or higher if freshness matters · For a sea view, specify the Seaview Suite at booking · Head up to KEE Sky Lounge before sunset to grab a seat at the view edge
pros: KEE Sky Lounge rooftop sunset bar — the most-praised highlight
Central Patong, walkable to the beach, Bangla and Jungceylon (location 9.2)
Rooms bigger than the central-Patong average, comfy beds · lagoon pool with a swim-up bar
cons: Value is the lowest-scoring category (7.9) — extras run higher than expected
Close to Bangla, so street-facing/low-floor rooms hear night-time noise
An older property — some room types show their age (from reviews)

entries.addr: 43/2 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Road, Patong, Kathu, Phuket
entries.storyHtml: If you want to be in the middle of Patong — walking to the beach, Jungceylon and Bangla — without paying beachfront-resort prices, Deevana Patong Resort & Spa is a name budget-minded travellers rebook · A 3-star garden resort of 235 rooms on Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Road, tucked around a tropical garden and two pools so the city noise drops the moment you step inside, with a poolside bar and Orientala Spa. What reviews mention most is value — Booking scores it 8.9 there, its highest category — plus a ~10-minute walk to the beach and Bangla, and a breakfast buffet that punches above its price. It scores 8.1 on Booking (8.2 from 3,581 reviews on Agoda) · The honest caveats: open since 2010, rooms are aging, rooms near the pool bar or street catch some noise, garden mosquitoes appear in the rainy season, and it's not a beachfront resort — ask for a renovated high-floor garden-side room and book low season · Best for budget-to-mid travellers, couples and friends who want a well-located, good-value base
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a renovated, high-floor garden-side room away from the pool bar and street to dodge noise and older rooms · Check whether your rate includes breakfast · Book Orientala Spa ahead and use the big pool early when it's quiet
pros: Value scored 8.9 — its highest category · ~10 min walk to the beach, Jungceylon and Bangla
Two pools in a tropical garden, the big one with a pool bar, quiet in the morning
Reasonably priced Orientala Spa and a generous breakfast buffet
cons: Aging rooms — some with dated furniture and limited storage
Rooms near the pool bar/street catch music and traffic · garden mosquitoes in the rainy season
Not a beachfront resort — a ~10-minute walk through sois to the sand (from reviews)

entries.storyHtml: If the brief is to sleep as close to Patong Beach as possible at a still-affordable price, The Bloc Hotel Phuket shows up on a lot of travellers' shortlists · A white, modern 63-room hotel on Thawewong Road at the Patong headland near the top of Bangla — step out, cross the road, and you're on the sand in about a minute, with Bangla just steps beyond. Its other draw is a rooftop pool with The Roof bar over Patong bay and the sunset. It scores 8.4 from 1,231 reviews, with location as high as 9.3 and staff at 9.1 · The honest caveats: it sits in the busiest part of Patong, so some rooms hear the street, bars and Bangla; the Superior rooms are compact (~22 sqm); breakfast is fairly limited; and the rooftop pool is small and crowds at peak — ask for a high floor away from the street and book low season · Best for couples, friends and solo travellers who want to sleep by the beach and walk to the nightlife on a four-digit budget
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Ask for a high floor away from the street/Bangla side if you want a quiet sleep · For a sea view, pick the Deluxe Partial Sea View (it's a partial view) · Head to the rooftop before sunset for the hotel's best moment

Rooftop pool + The Roof bar over Patong bay and the sunset

entries.name: Amari Phuket
entries.badge: 🌊 5★ on a quiet headland + private cove
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Southern end of Patong Beach, headland · ~5–10 min into town

rooms.type: Club One Bedroom Suite Ocean View

tags: 🌊 Quiet headland + a private cove, clear and uncrowded
🏊 3 swimming pools over Patong bay
🍝 La Gritta on the rocks, sunset views
🚕 ~5–10 min to Bangla / the main beach
entries.storyHtml: Patong is famous for a buzz that scares some people off, but Amari Phuket lives in a different world from the bars and night markets — perched on a rocky headland at the far southern end of Patong Beach, with its own small private cove that's clearer and far less crowded than the main sand, yet still a 5–10 minute drive to Bangla and the main beach · A 5-star Amari resort opened in 1984 and given a major 2013 refit, it has 380 seaside rooms, 3 pools, and La Gritta, an Italian restaurant on the rocks where you eat over the bay at sunset. It scores 8.6 from 371 Trip.com reviews (8.2 from 2,704 on Booking) · The honest caveats: it's a long-standing resort where parts and the older buildings show their age, it's on a hillside with stairs and slopes (lifts and buggies help), and at peak the pools and restaurants get full — pick an Ocean Front room facing the sea directly, or the newer Ocean Suites Wing · Best for people who want to enjoy Patong without sleeping in the middle of the noise
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Pay up for an Ocean Front/Ocean View room facing the sea directly — the balcony view over Patong bay is the highlight · Book La Gritta for sunset at check-in · If stairs are hard, ask for a low floor or one near a lift, and plan on Grab for trips into town
pros: Quiet headland with a private cove — clearer and less crowded than the main beach
Sea views over Patong bay from rooms and pools · La Gritta on the rocks at sunset
A beachfront 5-star from ~฿4,500 — far cheaper than the luxury resorts at Bang Tao/Surin
cons: A long-standing resort — parts and older buildings show their age, dated bathrooms
Hillside setting with stairs and slopes · a 5–10 minute drive into town every time
Pools and restaurants fill up at peak · the private cove is fairly small (from reviews)

entries.type: Boutique Design Hotel 4★ · IHG · rooftop pool
entries.name: Hotel Indigo Phuket Patong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Central Patong, Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee · walk to beach + Bangla
tags: 🏙️ Rooftop infinity pool + The Cloud bar

entries.addr: 124 Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee Road, Patong, Kathu, Phuket
entries.storyHtml: If you want to be central in Patong — walking to the beach and Bangla — but don't want another identical hotel, Hotel Indigo Phuket Patong is the pick for many · An IHG boutique-design hotel (the Hotel Indigo brand) that weaves Patong's fishing village, tropical forest and nightlife into every corner, its star is a rooftop infinity pool with The Cloud bar looking out over the whole neighbourhood. Opened in 2018 with 180 rooms (entry rooms a roomy ~38 sqm) and a 24-hour gym with a full Muay Thai ring, it scores 8.9 from 465 Trip.com reviews, with location as high as 9.4 · The honest caveats: it's in the thick of the buzz, so street-facing rooms hear traffic and nightlife, housekeeping can be inconsistent on some days, and a service charge is added that's worth checking in your total — this is not a quiet beachfront resort · Best for people visiting Patong to walk the town, eat and drink, and enjoy a good-looking design hotel with a rooftop pool for the evenings
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Head to the rooftop pool before sunset to claim a good lounger before it fills · If you're a light sleeper, ask for a high floor not facing the main street · Check that your total includes service charge and tax before you confirm
pros: Rooftop infinity pool + The Cloud bar with lovely evening views · scores 8.9
Distinctive local-story design, rooms bigger than the same tier
Walk to the beach, Bangla and Jungceylon (location 9.4) · a 24-hour Muay Thai ring
cons: Central location — street-facing rooms hear traffic and nightlife
Not on the beach (a 7–10 minute walk) · not a quiet, relaxing resort
Inconsistent housekeeping some days · a service charge is added, check your total (from reviews)

rooms.type: Dorm bed, privacy pod (female dorm available)

entries.storyHtml: If you think a hostel means a cramped room and packed bunk beds and nothing more, Lub d Phuket Patong will change your mind · A social hostel in central Patong with an outdoor pool, pool parties, a bar, a Muay Thai gym and a co-working zone all in one place, about 150 metres (a 3-minute walk) from Patong Beach and close to Bangla. Dorm beds are privacy pods with a curtain, reading light, power and an in-pod locker, from about ฿450/night, with private rooms from around ฿850. It scores 9.2 from 464 reviews — very high for a hostel — and won Best Hostel at the 2025 Global Youth Travel Awards · The honest caveats: it leans social and sits in central Patong, so nights get loud from activities and the surrounding area, some rooms and dorms are small, and it's worth checking recent reviews on cleanliness before booking · Best for solo travellers, backpackers and groups of friends who come to Patong to have fun, meet people and get around on foot
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Solo and want to meet people? Take a dorm bed and join the pool party and pub crawl · Light sleeper? Choose an inner private room away from the pool and street, and pack earplugs · Check the latest 1–2 months of reviews on cleanliness before booking
pros: A hostel with a pool and pool parties — easy to meet people · a very high 9.2 score
Central Patong, 3 min to the beach, near Bangla (location 9.5) · from ฿450
Privacy-pod dorm beds with in-pod lockers · a Muay Thai gym and co-working
cons: A social/party hostel — loud at night, not for quiet-seekers or families with young kids
Some rooms and dorms are small, with limited space for big luggage
Worth checking the latest reviews on cleanliness before booking (from reviews)

advice.head: You want a real Patong beachfront, sea from the room
advice.bodyHtml: → Four Points by Sheraton ฿3,500 — north-end beachfront, saltwater + rooftop pools · Holiday Inn ฿3,400 across the road from the sand · or The Bloc ฿1,700 on the headland, 1 minute to the sand

advice.head: Bringing the family, kids entertained all day
advice.bodyHtml: → Holiday Inn Resort Phuket ฿3,400 — 6 pools, a kids' slide pool, Kids Club, kids stay free on terms · or Four Points ฿3,500 with a kids' pool and beachfront kids club

advice.head: A couple/honeymoon, design and atmosphere first
advice.bodyHtml: → Burasari ฿2,900 — a garden boutique with outdoor-tub Honeymoon rooms · or Hotel Indigo ฿3,800 — a design hotel with a rooftop infinity pool

advice.head: Nightlife, walk to Bangla, love a rooftop bar
advice.bodyHtml: → The Kee Resort & Spa ฿2,000 — the KEE Sky Lounge rooftop bar, walk to the beach/Bangla · or The Bloc ฿1,700 on the headland by Bangla with a rooftop pool

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting rates from the standard-room range outside peak dates and may change by date and season — always check live prices and compare all 3 sites before booking · Scores and highlights in this guide come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms; we did not stay as guests · Phuket's high season (November–April) brings clearly higher rates, so plan ahead · Patong is the island's liveliest neighbourhood, and the town-centre and near-Bangla stays carry night-time noise — light sleepers should ask for a high-floor inner room or choose the south-Patong/headland zones · The headland and Tri-Trang stays (Amari, Marriott Merlin) mean a drive into town, so budget for Grab · A guide by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travellers often ask about Patong Beach hotels in Phuket

faq.q: ❓ What is the best hotel on Patong Beach?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style and budget · Going by score, Phuket Marriott Merlin Beach at 9.0 — a private-beach resort on Patong's southern edge — leads the list · For a real Patong beachfront, Four Points by Sheraton at 8.6 (the biggest review base, 5,078) or Holiday Inn across from the sand · For nightlife on a mid budget, The Kee at 8.4 with a rooftop bar and a walk to Bangla · On a budget, Deevana at ฿1,300 or Lub d, a hostel with a pool scoring 9.2 at ฿450

faq.q: ❓ How much do Patong Beach hotels cost?
faq.a: The stays in this guide start at roughly ฿450–4,900 per night · At the light end: Lub d from ฿450 (a dorm bed with a pool) and Deevana ฿1,300 · Mid-range: The Bloc ฿1,700, The Kee ฿2,000, Burasari ฿2,900 · Beachfront/resort tier: Holiday Inn ฿3,400, Four Points ฿3,500, Hotel Indigo ฿3,800, Amari ฿4,500 and Marriott Merlin ฿4,900 · All are approximate off-peak starting rates; high season (November–April) runs clearly higher

faq.q: ❓ Which Patong hotels are actually beachfront?
faq.a: The genuinely beachfront/on-the-beach stays here are Four Points by Sheraton ฿3,500 (north-end beachfront, sea from the room), Holiday Inn ฿3,400 (across the road, ~1 minute to the sand) and The Bloc ฿1,700 (headland by Bangla, 1 minute to the sand) · Amari and Marriott Merlin are 5-star resorts with their own private beach on a headland/quiet bay, but they need a drive into town

faq.q: ❓ Is Patong good for families, and where should they stay?
faq.a: Yes, if you pick the right zone · The most family-built option is Holiday Inn Resort Phuket ฿3,400 — 6 pools, a kids' slide pool, an underwater-themed Kids Club and a Kids Stay & Eat Free programme · Next are Four Points ฿3,500 (kids' pool and a beachfront kids club) and Phuket Marriott Merlin Beach ฿4,900 (a quiet private beach and butterfly garden) · Avoid a party hostel like Lub d if you're bringing young children

faq.q: ❓ Which part of Patong should I stay in — how do the zones differ?
faq.a: On the beach road (Thawewong) — sea from the room or cross the road to the sand (Four Points, Holiday Inn, The Bloc) · Town centre, Rat-U-Thit 200 Pee — walk to the beach and Bangla, lighter on price, good for nightlife (The Kee, Deevana, Hotel Indigo, Lub d) · South Patong, Ruamjai soi — a garden boutique 2–3 minutes from the sand (Burasari) · Headland / Tri-Trang — a quiet private beach, a drive into town, good for families and couples (Amari, Marriott Merlin) · Want to walk home after Bangla? Stay central. Want peace and quiet? Choose the headland

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book, and how do I get to Patong?
faq.a: In Phuket's high season (November–April), book 1–2 months ahead, especially over New Year and Songkran when rates rise and the good rooms go first · In low season (May–October), 1–2 weeks is plenty and rates drop clearly · Getting there: Patong is about 40–50 minutes from Phuket Airport (HKT) by pre-booked taxi, hotel transfer or Grab · The town centre is walkable without a car · Every platform offers Free Cancellation rates — lock one in early if your plans might shift, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price
